intro.title: Write a function to chunk an array by size
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that splits a given array into smaller sub-arrays, or 'chunks,' of a specified size. You will learn how to use a loop to iterate through the array and the slice method to extract each chunk. The main JavaScript constructs involved are arrays, functions, loops, and conditional logic. This exercise will help you practice breaking down problems and manipulating array data. By the end, you'll have a reusable function that can chunk any array you provide.
intro.usecase: The array chunking pattern is essential for pagination systems in web applications, where large datasets need to be displayed in manageable sections. You'll see this in e-commerce product grids that show items in rows of 3 or 4, social media feeds that load batches of posts, and dashboard widgets that display data in organized panels. As a developer, you'll implement chunking when building carousels, creating paginated API responses, or organizing data visualization components into structured layouts.
